neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the billing schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Recurring subscription invoices with point-in-time issue, due, and settlement fields.
assets.use_when: Billed recurring revenue, collections, invoice aging, and subscription economics.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not infer cash collection from invoice_status without checking payment attempts.
quality_notes: Billing-cutover invoices arrived later than normal in the warehouse.

assets.description: Every authorization or collection attempt, including failures and retries.
assets.use_when: Payment success, retries, decline analysis, and cash collection timing.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not count requested_amount_cents as settled cash and do not compare raw decline codes across processors without mapping them.
quality_notes: Decline taxonomy changed during the September 2025 processor migration.
The migration also caused a real, temporary increase in token and authorization failures.

assets.description: Current subscription contract state for monitoring and priority-service plans.
assets.use_when: Current subscription populations, plan mix, tenure, and recurring-revenue analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not use the current status as a point-in-time historical label without subscription events.
quality_notes: Current state includes corrections received through the frozen extract.

assets.description: Lifecycle events used to reconstruct subscription state at a historical cutoff.
assets.grain: One row per subscription lifecycle event
assets.use_when: Historical subscription state and churn timing analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not count lifecycle events as subscriptions.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the catalog schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Point-in-time monthly subscription pricing.
assets.grain: One row per service plan and annual price period.

assets.description: Canonical product, equipment, part, consumable, and accessory master.
Two-level product and part hierarchy.
Channel-specific product list-price history.
assets.grain: One row per product, channel, and effective price period.
assets.use_when: Use for point-in-time price reconstruction rather than current product price.

assets.description: Approved alternatives used during inventory shortages.
assets.grain: One ranked substitute product for a requested product.

assets.description: Current subscription and service-plan definitions.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the commerce schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Current commerce order header, including canonical and source identifiers.
assets.use_when: Order-level revenue, channel, lifecycle, and fulfillment analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not treat source_order_id as globally unique or as the order primary key.
quality_notes: HarborHome source order numbers collide during the acquisition migration.
Source timestamps from part of the acquired estate were parsed as UTC despite being local time.

assets.description: Append-oriented order lifecycle event stream from commerce source systems.
assets.grain: One row per recorded order event
assets.use_when: Sequence-aware order funnel and processing-time analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not assume source_recorded_at is event time on acquired HarborHome records.
quality_notes: Some acquired source clocks are five hours behind canonical event time.

assets.description: Commercial line items at the price and tax captured when an order was placed.
assets.use_when: Product mix, basket, discount, and item-level revenue analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not join product_id to a current catalog price to reconstruct historical revenue.

assets.description: Carrier and local-fleet tracking events for fulfilled orders.
assets.grain: One row per shipment tracking event
assets.use_when: Delivery lead time, carrier performance, and fulfillment experience analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not count event rows as shipments; an order normally has several events.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the core schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Current branch master used by sales, service, fleet, and workforce systems.
assets.use_when: Use as the canonical branch-to-region mapping.

assets.description: Canonical daily calendar with calendar and April-start fiscal attributes.
assets.grain: One row per calendar date in the generated world.

assets.description: Generic source-key to canonical-entity crosswalk for acquired and retired systems.
assets.grain: One source-system identifier for one canonical entity and validity period.
assets.use_when: Use to reconcile legacy identifiers before joining acquired-system records.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not join canonical_entity_id across entity types without filtering entity_type.
quality_notes: The canonical target is polymorphic, so it is documented rather than enforced as a physical FK.

assets.description: Department and team hierarchy used for ownership and workforce assignment.
assets.grain: One row per current organizational unit.

assets.description: Synthetic postal geographies mapped to service territories.
Stable corporate sales and service regions.
assets.use_when: Use for stable regional reporting and timezone assignment.

assets.description: Dispatch and market territories, each with a default servicing branch.
assets.grain: One row per current service territory.

assets.description: Canonical business and technical events that create coherent cross-domain effects.
assets.use_when: Use to explain known disruptions and policy changes across domains.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not assume every downstream anomaly is linked to a registered world event.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the crm schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Commercial relationship master; several customers can belong to one account.
Effective membership of customers in commercial accounts.
Append-only account lifecycle transitions.
assets.grain: One status transition for one account.

assets.description: Append-only consent actions by purpose and contact channel.
assets.grain: One consent action for one customer/contact/purpose.
assets.use_when: Use the latest applicable event at the decision time; do not treat rows independently.

assets.description: Synthetic email, telephone, and mailing contact points.
assets.grain: One contact point for one customer and effective period.
quality_notes: Values are non-routable synthetic identifiers.

assets.description: Canonical synthetic customer-party master; names and contact attributes are fabricated.
assets.grain: One row per known person or small-business party.
quality_notes: All identities are synthetic; display names intentionally repeat.

assets.description: Synthetic physical locations at which products are installed or field service occurs.
assets.grain: One row per serviceable physical site.
quality_notes: Addresses and coordinates are synthetic.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the external schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Daily synthetic residential energy prices by region and utility type.
assets.grain: One region, date, and utility-type price.

assets.description: Regional holidays, closures, and major local events.
assets.grain: One dated calendar event in one region.

assets.description: Annual modeled demographic estimates at synthetic postal-area level.
assets.grain: One postal area and calendar year estimate.
quality_notes: Modeled estimates contain sampling uncertainty and must not be interpreted as household-level facts.

assets.description: Sampled service-area traffic conditions from a licensed provider.
assets.grain: One provider revision for a sampled service-area hour.
quality_notes: Some area-hours have a revised second observation; choose a revision policy before aggregation.

assets.description: Hourly weather observations covering all company operating regions.
Synthetic reference weather stations mapped to operating regions.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the field_ops schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Customer-facing booked service windows.
Actual technician arrivals, departures, and visit outcomes.
assets.grain: One physical or attempted service visit.

assets.description: Current work-order record combining request, scheduling, and final operational fields.
assets.grain: One requested unit of field work.
quality_notes: Current-status extract contains post-assignment outcomes and should not be used directly as a point-in-time feature table.

assets.description: Convenient analytical work-order row mixing point-in-time predictors with final outcomes.
assets.grain: One work order in the current analytical extract.
quality_notes: Final resolution and completion fields leak future information for assignment-time models.

assets.description: Free-text technician, dispatcher, customer, and system notes.
assets.grain: One note attached to one work order.

assets.description: Parts consumed, returned, or recorded against field work.
assets.grain: One product line recorded against one service visit.

assets.description: Append-only lifecycle history for work orders.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the finance schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Monthly cost-center planning scenarios and revisions.
assets.grain: One cost center, month, and scenario.

assets.description: General-ledger account hierarchy for the synthetic company.
Management-reporting cost centers aligned imperfectly to branches.
Posted and draft general-ledger journal headers.
Debit and credit posting lines with optional operational dimensions.
assets.grain: One line within one journal entry.
quality_notes: The generated ledger resembles operational accounting data but is not guaranteed to balance by journal in v0.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the fleet schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Fuel and public charging transactions for fleet vehicles.
Synthetic vehicle location telemetry for completed and partial routes.
Preventive and corrective maintenance performed on fleet vehicles.
Daily technician vehicle routes before and after dispatch optimization.
assets.grain: One vehicle-technician route on one date.

assets.description: Planned and actual field-service stops within routes.
assets.grain: One work-order stop on one route.
quality_notes: A work order can appear on multiple routes after rescheduling.

assets.description: Fleet vehicle master for route, GPS, maintenance, and technician assignment data.
Effective-dated technician use of fleet vehicles.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the growth schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Registry of customer-growth experiments and their predeclared primary metrics.
assets.use_when: Experiment metadata, active windows, and metric definitions.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not infer assignment or outcomes from the registry alone.

assets.description: Randomized experiment assignment and first-exposure records at session grain.
assets.use_when: Intent-to-treat experiment analysis using the declared assignment unit.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not join to web events without first preserving assignment grain; that creates event-count weighting.

assets.description: Web and mobile sessions, including anonymous visits and attributable order conversions.
assets.use_when: Traffic, attribution, digital funnel, conversion, and experiment analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not equate visitor_id with a person; acquisition cutover reset and reused some identifiers.
quality_notes: HarborHome visitor identifiers were reset during acquisition integration.

assets.description: Ordered digital interaction events emitted within customer sessions.
assets.grain: One row per web or app interaction event
assets.use_when: Pathing, funnel, engagement, and experiment-outcome analysis.
assets.do_not_use_when: Do not join directly to experiment assignments and aggregate rows without controlling event-count fanout.
quality_notes: Event volume is an outcome and should not be mistaken for independent sampling units.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the iot schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Installed equipment currently or formerly associated with a service site.
assets.use_when: Connecting service, telemetry, and maintenance histories to a physical unit.
assets.do_not_use_when: Treating an account as a single device or assuming current site is historical site.

assets.description: Daily asset-health feature snapshot combining telemetry, alerts, firmware, and delayed outcomes.
assets.do_not_use_when: Building point-in-time models without enforcing label and feature availability timestamps.
quality_notes: Contains eventual outcome fields that are not available at snapshot time.
Missingness changes during severe weather.

assets.description: Effective installation and removal episodes for physical assets.
quality_notes: Legacy acquisition removals can arrive several days late.

assets.description: Device alerts derived from telemetry and business rules.
Logical telemetry channels belonging to installed assets.
assets.grain: One sensor or logical measurement channel.

assets.description: Observed telemetry readings with event, recording, and warehouse-availability times.
quality_notes: Storm-period missingness is informative.
Firmware v5 changed measurement behavior.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the platform schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Wide point-in-time account feature store with outcomes intentionally co-located for auditing exercises.
assets.grain: One account at one feature-as-of timestamp; multiple snapshots per account are expected.
assets.use_when: Point-in-time feature inspection after checking source watermarks and excluding outcome columns.
assets.do_not_use_when: Selecting columns by convenience for a training cutoff or claiming a current customer state.
quality_notes: The final three columns are future outcomes and constitute target leakage if used as predictors.
Some upstream features arrive up to 96 hours after their event; source_watermark_at records availability.

assets.description: Automated and sampled quality checks emitted by pipeline runs.
assets.grain: One check result for one asset in one run.
quality_notes: A PASS is evidence about a named check, not certification of an entire asset.

assets.description: Online and batch model scores with version, threshold, and decision lineage.
assets.grain: One scored account request by one model version.

assets.description: Registry of analytical models and decision-support systems.
Versioned model artifacts with training lineage and validation summaries.
Batch and streaming pipeline definitions with operational ownership.
Execution history for registered data pipelines.
assets.grain: One orchestrator attempt for one pipeline.

assets.description: Registry of operational and third-party data sources.
assets.grain: One source system or provider integration.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the supply schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Warehouse receipts against individual purchase-order lines.
assets.grain: One receipt event for one PO line.

assets.description: Signed stock movements from purchasing, field usage, transfers, and adjustments.
assets.grain: One posted inventory movement event; replayed scanner events remain separate records.
quality_notes: A November 2025 handheld retry defect replayed a subset of otherwise identical business movements.

assets.description: Sampled daily product/warehouse inventory positions with trailing operational metrics.
assets.grain: One sampled product, warehouse, and snapshot-date position.
quality_notes: The v0 extract is a dense analytical sample, not a complete warehouse-product date spine.

assets.description: Approved vendor sourcing options for each product.
Purchase-order headers for parts and equipment procurement.
Products and quantities ordered on purchase orders.
assets.grain: One line item on a purchase order.

assets.description: Canonical synthetic supplier and service-vendor master.
Distribution-center master used by purchasing, inventory, and fulfillment.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the support schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Conversation containers attached to support tickets.
Post-resolution satisfaction surveys retaining original rating scale.
quality_notes: Scores use both 1-5 and 1-10 scales; normalized_score is the comparable field.

assets.description: Knowledge-base article registry.
Knowledge article view and optional helpfulness telemetry.
Synthetic support messages with redaction and sentiment metadata.
quality_notes: Message text is synthetic but intentionally treated as restricted for realistic governance practice.

assets.description: Customer support cases from operational and migration-era sources.
assets.grain: One source-system ticket; interaction_fingerprint is the cross-system reconciliation key.
quality_notes: A two-month dual-write window creates business-event duplicates across distinct ticket IDs.

assets.description: Append-only status changes for support cases.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the trust schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Append-only account consent and withdrawal events by purpose.
assets.grain: One consent-state change for one account and purpose.
quality_notes: Current consent must be derived in event time by purpose; action rows are not a current-state snapshot.

assets.description: Synthetic audit log of governed employee access to data products.
quality_notes: row_count_estimate is produced by clients and is not authoritative usage metering.

assets.description: Synthetic privacy rights requests and fulfillment status.

neighborhoods.description: Assets registered in the workforce schema. Start with an anchor asset, then reveal related tables as the question requires.

assets.description: Synthetic employee absence episodes linked to scheduled shifts.
assets.grain: One absence episode affecting a scheduled shift.

assets.description: Synthetic employee master without protected demographic attributes.
quality_notes: All employee identities are synthetic; protected attributes are intentionally absent.

assets.description: Effective-dated role, team, and branch assignments.
Scheduled shifts for field and branch-based employees.
Product-level field-technician qualifications.
Employee learning completions and failed attempts.
